_meta.method: Merged from two research passes: (A) BuddhaNet World Buddhist Directory, Plum Village monastic practice-centre directory, Dharma Drum Mountain affiliate list, Chung Tai Chan global directory, Kwan Um School of Zen center listings, Western Chan Fellowship trip reports, and mainstream travel/tourism listings for major Chan/Zen monasteries; (B) earlier pass on Foguangshan and Chi Lin Nunnery.
_meta.coverageEstimate: High for institutional Chan/Zen practice centers (Plum Village, DDM, Chung Tai, Kwan Um, Foguangshan, traditional monasteries). Lower for smaller lay sanghas.
knownGaps: Smaller Plum Village lay sanghas in Hong Kong not enumerated.
Local lay Zen/Chan groups that meet in rented rooms or private homes and are not listed in public directories are excluded to avoid unverifiable, shifting locations.
Macau Chan temples not yet surveyed.

places.name: Po Lin Monastery (Po Lin Chansi)
places.address: Ngong Ping Plateau, Lantau Island, Hong Kong
places.notes: The monastery’s official site identifies Po Lin Chan Monastery at Ngong Ping and publishes current visitor hours and activities. A current recurring public meditation schedule was not found. Native: 寶蓮禪寺.

places.name: Lotus Pond Temple (Plum Village Hong Kong, Asian Institute of Applied Buddhism)
places.address: Lotus Pond Temple, Ngong Ping, Lantau Island, Hong Kong
places.notes: Official Plum Village Hong Kong monastic practice centre at Lotus Pond Temple, home of the Asian Institute of Applied Buddhism. Its site publishes current 2026 activities; consult the calendar before visiting. Native: 蓮池寺 / 亞洲應用佛學院.

places.name: Su Bong Zen Monastery
places.notes: Urban Zen center founded in 1992 and named after Zen Master Su Bong, serving as the main Kwan Um School of Zen monastery in Hong Kong. Offers zazen, kong-an (koan) interviews, retreats, and regular group practice under teachers authorized in the Kwan Um School lineage of Seung Sahn. Listed in the BuddhaNet World Buddhist Directory as a Mahayana center in the Kwan Um School of Zen, with Zen Master Dae Kwan as resident teacher. Native: 秀峰禪院 (Xiùfēng Chán Yuàn).

places.name: Gak Su Temple International Zen Center
places.notes: Mountain Zen temple and retreat center of Su Bong Zen Monastery, located in Luk Wu on Lantau Island, an area with a 130-year history of Buddhist hermitages. Identified by BuddhaNet as 'Gak Su Mountain Temple', a Mahayana center in the Kwan Um School of Zen founded by Zen Master Seung Sahn with Zen Master Dae Kwan as teacher. Hosts intensive Kyol Che retreats and residential practice periods for monks, nuns, and lay practitioners following Kwan Um School forms. Native: 覺修禪寺 (Juéxiū Chán Sì).

places.name: Puguang Meditation Center (Chung Tai Chan Monastery Hong Kong Branch)
places.address: G/F, Kingstown Mansion, 319-323 Jaffe Road, Wan Chai, Hong Kong
places.notes: Urban Chan meditation center functioning as the Hong Kong branch of Chung Tai Chan Monastery, a major contemporary Chan organization. BuddhaNet lists Puguang Meditation Center as a Mahayana Linji Chan center affiliated with Chung Tai Chan Monastery, providing contact details and location in Hong Kong. Chung Tai's global directory notes Hong Kong among its overseas branches, with Puguang as its local meditation center serving city practitioners. Native: 普光精舍 (Pǔguāng Jīngshè).

places.name: Dharma Drum Mountain Hong Kong Center (DDM Hong Kong)
places.address: 2/F, Block B, Alexandra Industrial Building, 23-27 Wing Hong Street, Lai Chi Kok, Hong Kong
places.notes: City practice center of Dharma Drum Mountain founded by Chan Master Sheng Yen, listed by BuddhaNet as a Mahayana Chinese Chan (Zen) organization in Lai Chi Kok, Kowloon. DDM's global affiliates and related listings confirm DDM Hong Kong as an official branch offering Chan meditation, Dharma classes, and community programs in the Dharma Drum lineage. Registered locally as Dharma Drum Mountain Foundation (Hong Kong Branch) with the same Wing Hong Street address and website. Native: 法鼓山香港道場 (Fǎgǔshān Xiānggǎng Dàochǎng).

places.name: Po Lam Monastery (Po Lam Chan Monastery)
places.address: Tei Tong Tsai, Lantau Island, Hong Kong
places.notes: A 2026 Hong Kong Town Planning Board document describes Po Lam Zen Monastery as operating at Tei Tong Tsai and promoting meditation. Detailed daily-training descriptions are historical, so no current public sitting schedule is asserted. Native: 寶林寺.
